thread:
alex: heads-up — launching a config-only canary in ~15m (us-west1) for routing + batching tweaks. Goal: validate latency & error behavior under tinybatch and softer timeouts before wider rollout. plan: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 2h if green.

alex: config blob we’ll push:
```json
{
  \"canary_id\": \"cfg-canary-twilight-1734\",
  \"routes\": {\"primary\": 0.9, \"fallback\": 0.1},
  \"batching\": {\"tiny_batch_size\": 8, \"max_batch_delay_ms\": 25},
  \"timeouts_ms\": {\"request_timeout\": 8000, \"kv_cache_ttl_ms\": 300000},
  \"concurrency\": {\"max_inflight_per_shard\": 180},
  \"pin\": {\"model_version\": \"v1.12-quant\"}
}
```

deploy-bot: @channel scheduled config-only canary \"cfg-canary-twilight-1734\" — starting in 15m. Links: https://deploys.redwood/canaries/cfg-canary-twilight-1734 :spiral_calendar_pad: 

priya: quick q — are we pinning model and tokenizer compat? i saw past mem/kv evictions with v1.12 on tinybatch.

alex: yes pinning to v1.12-quant and the tokenizer patch 2026-02-02. we kept kv_cache_ttl high to avoid cold misses.

taylor: what are the concrete watch signals? list please so SRE knows thresholds.

devops-oncall: watching 95p latency, p99, error-rate, downstream 5xxs, and kv-cache evictions. rollback triggers I’ll follow unless team wants to override: 95p > 300ms sustained >5m, or error-rate increase >50% vs baseline, or sudden >10% token cost change. I’ll be oncall for this window. @alex @priya

jordan: acked. I’ll keep an eye on per-route tails. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: cfg-canary-twilight-1734 started — 10% traffic to primary route. Observability links: dashboards/latency-twilight | traces/cfg-canary-twilight-1734

alex: monitoring dashboard pinned: https://console.redwood/release-monitoring/twilight-canary — alerting set to channel #eng-oncall and pager if thresholds hit. I’ll be online for the 30m and 60m checks.

(priya) 1734568120: noticed a small 95p spike at +7m (about +5%), correlating with an increase in batching delay metric. attaching brief log excerpt:
```
[2026-01-12T21:07:12Z] shard-5 batch_wait_ms=28 tiny_batch=8 inflight=162 kv_evictions=3
[2026-01-12T21:07:12Z] p95_latency_ms=210 p99_latency_ms=460 errors_per_min=1
```

alex: thanks. that blip aligns with a tenant burst; not systemic yet. question: do we want to trial tiny_batch_size=4 for a subset of canary traffic?

devops-oncall: propose AB: split canary 50/50 between tiny_batch 8 and tiny_batch 4 on different shards, keep other config identical. If 4 wins on p95 without cost jump, promote. If mixed signals, rollback.

taylor: AB sounds good. can we do weighted routing change rather than new deploy? i.e., route rule -> weight 0.5 to shard-group-b and 0.5 to shard-group-a.

alex: ok do it. new canary patch (routing + batch override). small JSON patch:
```json
{
  \"canary_id\": \"cfg-canary-twilight-1734-ab\",
  \"overrides\": {
    \"shard_group_a\": {\"tiny_batch_size\": 8},
    \"shard_group_b\": {\"tiny_batch_size\": 4}
  },
  \"route_weights\": {\"shard_group_a\": 0.5, \"shard_group_b\": 0.5}
}
```

deploy-bot: patch applied to cfg-canary-twilight-1734 — ab test active at 10% total (5% each). Watch dashboards for the next 20m.

priya: seeing p95 for shard_group_b (tiny_batch=4) drop ~40ms and p99 stable. costs look same so far. great sign.

devops-oncall: after 18m AB: shard_group_b p95 = 180ms vs shard_group_a p95 = 220ms. error rates equal. I recommend promoting 50% -> 80% then full if stable.

jordan: +1 promote path.

alex: promote to 80% now. deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: promoting canary route weights: primary route -> 80% (shard_group_b), fallback 20%. Change logged: https://deploys.redwood/canaries/cfg-canary-twilight-1734/changes/1

(15m later) devops-oncall: we saw a transient p99 spike at +53m (around 520ms) tied to a single hot tenant; not across others. Spike resolved after traffic rebalancing. No further action.

alex: ok leaving in place and continuing ramp to 100% over remaining hour. please add follow-up note to release-notes: brief on tiny_batch AB and reason for pin to v1.12-quant.

priya: writing release note draft now, will post in #product-release when ready.

deploy-bot: canary cfg-canary-twilight-1734 completed rollout to 100% at 1734568367 — change applied as config-only. Release artifact: https://deploys.redwood/releases/rel-2026-01-config-twilight-1734

alex: thanks everyone — nice safe AB. postmortem: none required but we’ll track any regressions for 72h. follow-up: proposal to add auto-AB for batch-size in Optimize recommendations.

jordan: nice work :tada:
notes: config-only canary, AB test, short-lived spike handled; rollback criteria discussed
